items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Who would he sound like if you'd know Traylor?

ctx.x: No, no he didn't because I mean Tom Alvitt was a great guy.
What did Moiré and Moiré and Alonso play like? Who would he sound like if you'd know Traylor?

Well, he was on pointy style. Yeah, he was on pointy style. Righty? Yeah. What about his finger? Did he have much finger? Yeah, a lot of finger. Just, you know, like some guys would let a little licker get ahead of him and my daddy would go for him, I'd be looking for him and show up. There he was. He wasn't there. But he was a good little trumpet player. When he was there, he was a good little trumpet player. Yeah, yeah. Did you know Willie Davis that played guitar?
